themes.name: Agentic AI in research

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: AI applications that directly support the design process, from generating prototypes to analyzing design data and aiding in the creation of visual assets.

themes.description: Articles detailing AI platforms and tools specifically built to facilitate and accelerate various forms of research, from drug discovery to market analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: AI tools and techniques used to condense large amounts of text, meetings, or data into concise summaries for easier understanding.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications that automate or enhance the analysis of data for insights, particularly in areas like customer behavior and market trends.

themes.name: AI usability testing

themes.name: AI testing automation
